title: scene-00: duplicate SceneAvatar create, updated vs alreadyExists SetError
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md conflicts on a create while the user already has an active SceneAvatar (leftAt: null) in the same region: L2015 says the server MUST return the existing record in `updated` rather than creating a duplicate; L2196 says the server MUST NOT create a duplicate and MUST return an `alreadyExists` SetError in notCreated with existingId. RFC 8620 alreadyExists (with existingId) is the /set convention for this case; returning an object in `updated` for a create is unusual. Pick one and fix the other. Blocks crate-jmap Scene base SceneAvatar handlers. Source: crate-jmap spec gap audit 2026-10-19.
notes:
Blocks crate-jmap JMAP-38uq.5 (SceneAvatar handlers).
DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: keep scene-00 L2196 (alreadyExists SetError in notCreated with existingId, RFC 8620 §5.3). Rewrite the L2015 sentence to match, and add that clients reconnecting SHOULD treat alreadyExists as 'already entered' and use existingId.
close_reason: Fixed in 91672c9 (spec: fix SetError codes, settle open conflicts), pushed.
